bots.name: Homunculi Classic
bots.desc: The character-level model, fine-tuned for chat. The most conversational one.

bots.name: Homunculi A
bots.desc: The 24-hour training run (tokens, rotary positions), now fine-tuned for chat. About as good on facts as Classic.

bots.name: Haishool

bots.name: Haishool links explorer
bots.desc: Walk the knowledge graph step by step from one thing to another.

bots.name: Haishool Atoms
bots.desc: Next Haishool: elements, atoms and chemistry from checked rules. Link appears when it is ready.
